request: Heathrow to Cairo on 20 January. I go straight from the airport into the Nile water-sharing talks at the ministry, so I'd like business class if the policy allows it; otherwise economy is fine.

trip.purpose: Nile water-sharing talks at the Egyptian water ministry

sign_offs.name: Gareth Pryce
sign_offs.subject: AIR_TRAVEL
sign_offs.note: Approved: fly to Cairo for the water talks.

must_keep.quote: Air travel for journeys of less than 5 hours should be via economy class only.

For journeys of between 5 hours and 10 hours a business class flight may be purchased where: • bookings are not available in the lower class and the timing or date of the journey cannot be changed • if staff will be required to work immediately on arrival. • on disability/medical grounds.
must_keep.why: 5 to 10 hours: business in three listed cases

must_keep.quote: The lowest practical fare/rate should be selected within the permitted class of travel.
must_keep.why: the lowest practical fare within the permitted class

must_keep.quote: All air travel requires prior approval from a manager or approver.
must_keep.why: all air travel needs a manager's or approver's prior approval

design_notes: 299-minute nonstops: 'less than 5 hours' (strict), so economy class only (line 204), even though the traveller works on arrival. Business is declined; the lowest practical fare (line 187).
